title: Wren and the Ember
author: Mirabel Ishikawa
blurb: Elodie Winterbourne, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
